title: Distinguish Send and Sync Bounds
goal: Apply correct Send and Sync trait bounds to generic functions.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Send and Sync

hints: Moving an owned value into `std::thread::spawn` requires T: Send.
Moving a reference &'static T into `std::thread::spawn` requires &'static T to be Send, which is true if and only if T: Sync.
explanation: Send allows moving ownership of a value into another thread. Sync allows sharing references (&T) across thread boundaries because &T is Send if and only if T is Sync. T: Sync does not imply T: Send for owned values, and T: Send does not make sending references (&T) safe.
